derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might;

occurrences.text: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben–hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
